guesses.reason: The fawn-brindle coat with a white blaze and chest, slightly shortened muzzle, dark mask around the mouth, and loose upper lips (flews) are classic Boxer traits.

guesses.breed: American Pit Bull Terrier / American Staffordshire Terrier
guesses.reason: The broad, wedge-shaped head, muscular cheeks, rose/semi-folded ears, and stocky medium build suggest bully-terrier ancestry.
The white facial markings, sturdy chest, and moderately short, blocky muzzle could also reflect American Bulldog influence.

breed.appearance: Mina is a muscular, medium-sized dog with a short, glossy fawn coat overlaid with subtle dark brindle striping, a white blaze running from the forehead down the bridge of the nose, a white muzzle, and a broad white chest patch. She has a blocky head, a moderately short muzzle with a black nose, slightly droopy lips with dark pigment, and warm, deep brown almond-shaped eyes; her thin ears are semi-erect and fold over at the tips, with the right ear perked higher and flipped open to show its pink inside. In the photo she sits upright on a gray car seat wearing a teal martingale collar with a silver ring and a pink leash.
breed.fun_fact: Boxers are famous for their playful 'kidney bean' wiggle dance when they're happy, and they stay goofy, loving companions well into adulthood!
